name: Dive Bomber
source: Its only effect is on death (20% max health true damage); it has no op, so nothing runs.

name: Clown College

ops.why: Backstab: his own hits while he lives; from behind stays an open condition
the attack after Deceive: when Deceive happens is not proven

source: Text: Backstab on hits from behind; Deceive then a stronger next attack; on death 25% max health true damage and fear (no op).

name: DropBear

ops.why: Tibbers is summoned on death; periodic only stood in for it

source: Text: on death, summon Tibbers (250-750 +100% AP magic damage, 0.5 s stun).

name: Shark Bait

ops.why: the shark comes after his death; periodic only stood in for it

source: Text: on death you become shark bait; a shark then deals 120-350 + 30% missing health magic damage.

name: Hellbent

ops.why: the revive at 35-75% health needs his death at 10 stacks
the speed comes after the revive
the omnivamp comes after the revive

source: Text: at 10 stacks, on death you revive over 4 s; then adaptive force, speed toward enemies and omnivamp for 15 s; 90 s cooldown.
